items.title: Eddie Marrero Interview, 1961-10-11
items.q: he started from Buddy. He went with Buddy.

ctx.x: Then do you remember who, which bands he played in? Simon we're talking about now. Simon? Sure.

Bands around New Orleans? Yes. Well, he started from Buddy. He went with Buddy. Oh, they must have stood together for about twelve years. And from Buddy, he went to Rene. Kid Rene band. Stayed with them in front of us? He stayed with them all, long time. And he left Rene with Celestan Tuxedo band.
John was with them then too, wasn't he? John was with them then.

items.title: Eddie Marrero Interview, 1979-12-04
items.q: I just had come back with Buddy McKee from Florida.

ctx.x: Nice to meet you. So, you went to Montgomery with Jack Carey? Yeah, Montgomery with Jack Carey.

Uh huh. That was back in 21. I just come back with Buddy. That was in 23. Uh huh. 1923. He didn't yet? Yeah. Yeah? Uh huh. So good. Let me get my glasses. Now I don't read this book. Uh huh. But I didn't join his band, no. I just helped him out. Yeah. I just had come back with Buddy McKee from Florida. I should have been in Florida for years. I said, I come back with Buddy McKee from Florida. I said, I'm in Florida, yeah. John, you want to hear about New Yorkshire? Because it's plain lies about New Yorkshire. And…
He's not interested in Lewis Armstrong. He's interested in yours.
